content.comment_body: Hello, I have a weighing indicator that can communicate using Modbus. Can [product_name] read the attached data types? Which data types are supported? Also, is my configuration correct? Thank you for your helpful advice.
[product_name] uses Big Endian byte order (High byte, Low byte).
